name: AXB35 P-MODE Indicator
description:
Shows the position of the physical P-MODE button in the top bar, with the live APU power draw, on mini PCs built on the Sixunited AXB35-02 board: GMKtec EVO-X2, Bosgame M5, FEVM FA-EX9, Peladn YO1, NIMO AI MiniPC, Corsair AI Workstation 300.

Requires the ec_su_axb35 kernel driver, which this extension does not install: https://github.com/cmetz/ec-su_axb35-linux
Without it the indicator shows a question mark, and its menu links to the driver's installation instructions.
